items.title: 4.2.3 List: Best for Ordered Collections (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of when to use a list (PDF 117).

blocks.text: Tarteeb wale majmooe ke liye list istemal karein jab tarteeb ahem ho aur index se seedhi pohanch bhi chahiye: dynamic arrays jin mein aksar elements jurte ya hatte hon, sequences jaise kaamon ki list ya playlist, aur stacks, queues aur doosre structures ki bunyadi eent ke taur par.

blocks.prompt: Playlist list ka acha istemal kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Gaanon ki tarteeb hai, aur aap index se seedhe 5wein gaane par ja sakte ya gaane jor aur hata sakte hain.

items: List: index se pohanch wale tarteeb wale majmooe; doosre structures bhi banati hai.
